immuch360-av2: plays AV2 videos in Immuch360 Desktop, decoded by dav2d and served to the player as a y4m on
127.0.0.1

Usage:
  immuch360-av2 probe FILE|- [--threads N]
      what the start of an AV2 file holds (IVF or OBUs, - for the standard input), as one line of JSON
  immuch360-av2 serve --token TOKEN --width W --height H --bits 8|10 --fps NUM/DEN --frames N [options]
      decodes the temporal units of the standard input and serves the pictures as a virtual y4m at
      http://127.0.0.1:PORT/TOKEN/video.y4m, until the standard input closes
  immuch360-av2 --version
  immuch360-av2 --help

Options of serve:
  --token TOKEN          16 to 128 letters, digits, - or _: the first part of the path of the video
  --width W --height H   the size of the pictures, as the probe found it
  --bits 8|10            the depth of the pictures
  --fps NUM/DEN          the frame rate the y4m header gives the player
  --frames N             the number of pictures, one per temporal unit
  --threads N            threads of the decoder, 0 for every logical processor (default 0)
  --range limited|full   the colour range the y4m header gives the player (default limited)
  --depth 8              serves 10-bit pictures as 8-bit samples
  --frame-bytes B        stops unless a picture takes B bytes in the y4m
  --port P               the port to listen on (default 0, any free port)
  --parent PID           ends when the process PID ends (the app), as when the standard input closes

Standard input of serve: records of a 16-byte header, little endian ("AV2R", generation, unit, length), then
length bytes. First the index: generation 0, unit 4294967295, the random access units as 32-bit numbers.
Then, for each line "need G U", the temporal units from U on with generation G, and a record of length 0
after the last unit.
Standard output of serve: listening PORT, need G U, request, stat, refused, error and exit lines; serve ends
when they can no longer be written.
Exit codes: 0 the standard input or output closed, or the --parent process ended, 1 internal error, 2 bad
arguments, 3 the video cannot be decoded, 4 no socket on 127.0.0.1, 5 records that are not the protocol's.
